Validate current PPE pricing model and applied maxTotalChargeUsd
Never retry run-creation POST after an ambiguous response
Persist run ID immediately, keep dataset identity for verification

Record missing counters as unknown; public views are not reach

Video download and visual analysis require a separately bounded plan
